name: Ship Hardware
description: Three small add-ons help ship builds.

pages.title: Ship Hardware
pages.text:
[#](FFFFFF)[#]() **Key points**

- [#](FFFFFF)[#]() **Transmission and Linkage** links ships with joints, rods and bearings.
- **Encased Fluid Pipes** carry fluid through a balloon wall.
- **Weightworks** makes Copycats nearly weightless.

Small add-ons help ship builds. Transmission and Linkage moves force between ships, Encased Fluid Pipes hides pipes inside balloons, Weightworks lightens Copycats, and Aeronautics Compatibility makes other mods work on moving ships.

pages.title: Universal Joint Head
pages.text: Two heads and a rod link structures and pass [#](2E5AAC)[rotation](entry://create_basics/rotation)[#]() across. The brass rod is elastic. The andesite rod reaches 15 blocks and breaks if stretched too far.

pages.title: Pneumatic Rod
pages.text: A configurable strut between two pneumatic heads. Set target length, return force and stretch resistance. Free mode lets it slide.

pages.title: Pneumatic Regulator
pages.text: Place behind a pneumatic head. Redstone strength sets the rod length, and shaft speed sets how fast it moves.

pages.title: Hinge Head
pages.text: A pneumatic rod ends in a hinge head that swings around one axis while the rod sets only its length. The brass one has adjustable minimum and maximum angles.

pages.title: Giant Hydraulic Rod
pages.text: Heavy-duty rod with two settings: Valve Flow limits its speed, Supply Pressure limits its force. An overloaded rod slows or stalls. Made by [#](7A3C9A)[mechanical crafting](entry://glossary/mechanical_crafting)[#]().

pages.title: Kinetic Conversion Bearing
pages.text: Outputs the structure's real rotation speed to a shaft. Resistance is adjustable; [#](2E5AAC)[stress](entry://create_basics/stress)[#]() output is capped.

pages.title: Envelope Encased Pipe
pages.text: A [#](2E5AAC)[fluid pipe](entry://create_basics/fluids)[#]() sealed in envelope material, so pipes can pass through a balloon wall. Made from a fluid pipe and an envelope block, in all 16 colours.
Envelope pipes count as part of the balloon, so the hot air stays sealed. Use dye to recolour one in place. Sneak with a wrench to strip the casing and get it back.

pages.title: Compatibility
pages.text:
Aeronautics Compatibility makes blocks from mods that do not know about [#](7A3C9A)[sub-levels](entry://glossary/sub_level)[#]() keep working on ships. Jade Sable Compat does the same for Jade tooltips, and a [#](7A3C9A)[Copycats](entry://glossary/copycat)[#]() patch fixes an item duplication bug.\
\
**Weightworks** gives Copycat blocks almost no mass.

[#](FFFFFF)[#]() **In depth.** Right-click two matching joint heads with a rod. Ends must be on different structures, or one may be the world.\
\
An andesite rod pulls back after 1 block of stretch.\
\
The conversion bearing caps output at 200,000 SU.
